title: Alberta prepares for referendum vote, and what's next for Premier Danielle Smith?
summary: Chief political correspondent Rosemary Barton speaks with the Toronto Star’s Tonda MacCharles, Politico's Nick Taylor-Vaisey and CBC News's Jason Markusoff about the mood in Alberta following the…

blocks.text: Chief political correspondent Rosemary Barton speaks with the Toronto Star’s Tonda MacCharles, Politico's Nick Taylor-Vaisey and CBC News's Jason Markusoff about the mood in Alberta following the fire at CFB Wainwright and ahead of Monday's referendum vote. Then, the scrum discusses the political outlook for Alberta Premier Danielle Smith.
